raw_text: Russia reserves the right to use nuclear weapons in response to existential threats, senior Russian Security Council official stated during a press briefing. The official emphasized that NATO expansion and Western arms deliveries to Ukraine represent a direct threat to Russian strategic interests. Russia's nuclear doctrine remains unchanged but operational readiness has been enhanced.
clean_text: Russian Security Council official states Russia reserves right to use nuclear weapons against existential threats. NATO expansion and Ukraine arms cited as threats. Operational readiness enhanced.
